title: VasoJEPA — anatomy-aware JEPA for coronary angiography
description: Self-supervised pretraining framework on 171K unlabeled coronary angiograms. An exogenous vesselness anchor prevents representation collapse without an EMA teacher, outperforming models trained from scratch on vascular segmentation.

title: A deep learning approach in stenosis detection and coronary arteries segmentation
description: End-to-end vascular tree segmentation and focal stenosis localization on X-ray coronary angiograms. Features a multi-channel morphological input, EfficientNetV2 backbone, custom SubPixel upsampling with Deformable Convolutions (DCNv2), and Dual Attention. Trained with a composite Hybrid Loss (BCE + Soft-clDice for vascular continuity + Signed Distance Map).

title: Prostate cancer detection using deep neural Networks
description: Built an Attention U-Net model for prostate cancer segmentation from MRI scans, using k-fold cross-validation and medical imaging preprocessing.

title: Curabot
description: An AI-powered robotic arm that assists immobilized patients. The system integrates voice recognition, computer vision using a residual CNN on Raspberry Pi, and robotic control via Arduino and Braccio arm.

title: Medical multimeter
description: A Mega2560 based multimeter which is able to measure blood pressure, beats per minute and oxygen saturation.

title: Portfolio Website
description: A simple website to showcase my skills and my journey.
